   -> Error: no analysis yet for <root>: analyzers produced no variables/CFGs/uses for 1 analyzable file(s); index the repo first (exit 1)

== DESIGN NOTES / DEPENDENCIES ==
- Analysis provisioning: cache-first via analysis::load(root); when absent, learn() (CORE-7, landed) builds it,
  so first run on a fresh repo works. The literal "no analysis yet" error is preserved and fires when the
  analyzers return nothing despite analyzable files (proved above).
- report guardrails: rules::check(index, analysis, rules::load(root)); findings appended as `## Guardrails`
  and included in `--json` under "guardrails"; exit nonzero iff any Severity::Error (CORE-6 landed).
- refs uses refs::references_ex (TEXT-3) so name-only (unresolved) sites are labelled, never shown as confirmed.
- graph delegates all four diagrams to PROD-2 emitters; cfg requires --symbol; unknown/ambiguous -> nonzero.
- No new deps: JSON is hand-rolled; BTreeMap ordering keeps output deterministic.
